description_en: Call the ListIpMappingRules API to retrieve IP redirection information for authorization rules
description_zh: 调用ListIpMappingRules接口查询授权规则IP重定向信息
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc list-ip-mapping-rules --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIpMappingRules

parameters.help_en: ID of the cloud connector instance
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: IDs of authorization rules that require IP redirection
parameters.help_zh: 需要进行IP重定向的授权规则的ID
parameters.name: ip_mapping_rule_ids

parameters.help_zh: 需要进行重定向的IP地址
parameters.name: mapping_ips

parameters.help_en:
Status of IP redirection for authorization rules. You can specify up to 20 statuses. Valid values:

Creating: The rule is being created.

Created: The rule is created.

Updating: The rule is being updated.

Associating: An IP address is being attached.

Dissociating: An IP address is being detached.

Deleting: The rule is being deleted.

Deleted: The rule is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
授权规则IP重定向的状态。最多支持20个授权规则IP重定向的状态。取值：

Creating：创建中。

Created：创建完成。

Updating：更新中。

Associating：IP绑定中。

Dissociating：IP解绑中。

Deleting：删除中。

Deleted：已删除
parameters.name: ip_mapping_rule_statuses

parameters.help_en: Names of authorization rules that require IP redirection
parameters.help_zh: 需要进行IP重定向的授权规则名称
parameters.name: ip_mapping_rule_names

parameters.help_en:
Token for the next query. Valid values:

Omit this parameter for the first query or when no more results are available.

For subsequent queries, use the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to display per page when you query in batches. Valid values are 1 to 100. The default value is 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
ID of the region where the instance resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html API to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
